desc.text:
<color=#ffd780>Elemental Skill</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Deals 1</color> <color=#ff9999>Pyro DMG</color> <color=#ffffffa6>. Attaches</color> <color=#ffffff>Wushou Arts</color> <color=#ffffffa6>to self and switches to your next character.</color>
<color=#ece5d8>Wushou Arts</color>
<color=#ffd780>Status</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Before your character chooses their action, if the character to which this is attached is your active character, use the Skill:</color> <color=#ffffff>Charmed Cloudstrider</color> <color=#ffffffa6>.</color>

<color=#ffd780>Normal Attack</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Deal 2</color> <color=#ff9999>Pyro DMG</color> <color=#ffffffa6>. This Skill is considered a</color> <color=#ffffff>Plunging Attack</color> <color=#ffffffa6>.</color>

<color=#ffd780>Elemental Burst</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Deals 2</color> <color=#ff9999>Pyro DMG</color> <color=#ffffffa6>. Attaches</color> <color=#ffffff>Suanni: Man Chai</color> <color=#ffffffa6>to self.</color>
<color=#ece5d8>Suanni: Man Chai</color>
<color=#ffd780>Status</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>The attached character's Elemental Skill spends 1 fewer Elemental Die and deals +1 DMG.</color>
<color=#ffffff>When the attached character uses an Elemental Skill:</color> <color=#ffffffa6>If their current HP is 5 or higher, they don't spend their</color> <color=#ffffff>Usage(s)</color> <color=#ffffffa6>. Instead, they take 1 Piercing DMG.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Usage(s): 2</color>

Applies Pyro and can trigger the following Elemental Reactions:
<color=#ffffff>[</color> <color=#ff9999>Pyro</color> + <color=#99ffff>Cryo</color> <color=#ffffff>]</color> <color=#ffffff>Melt</color> : DMG +2 for this instance
<color=#ffffff>[</color> <color=#ff9999>Pyro</color> + <color=#80c0ff>Hydro</color> <color=#ffffff>]</color> <color=#ffffff>Vaporize</color> : DMG +2 for this instance
<color=#ffffff>[</color> <color=#ff9999>Pyro</color> + <color=#ffacff>Electro</color> <color=#ffffff>]</color> <color=#ffffff>Overloaded</color> : DMG +2 for this instance, the target is forcibly switched to the next character
<color=#ffffff>[</color> <color=#ff9999>Pyro</color> + <color=#99ff88>Dendro</color> <color=#ffffff>]</color> <color=#ffffff>Burning</color> : DMG +1 for this instance, creates a [ <color=#ffffff>Burning Flame</color> ] that will deal 1 Pyro DMG at the end of the Round (Takes effect once, max 2 stacks)

<color=#ece5d8>Physical DMG</color>
Physical DMG will not apply any Elements, nor can it engage in Elemental Reactions.
<color=#ece5d8>Plunging Attack</color>
After a character is switched in to be the Active Character, should their next Combat Action within this Round be a Normal Attack, it will be considered a Plunging Attack for the instance.
<color=#ece5d8>Usage(s)</color>
After this card's effect is triggered, 1 <color=#ffffff>Usage</color> of it will be consumed.
This card will be discarded immediately once it has 0 <color=#ffffff>Usages</color> remaining.
<color=#ece5d8>Piercing DMG</color>
Piercing DMG cannot be increased by any bonuses, but cannot be defended against using Shields or DMG Immunity either.
